R181.note: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('base64url') replaces Math.random; token stays an opaque URL-safe string, nothing else changed.

R182.note: django.utils.html.escape() applied to the user value before it is interpolated and mark_safe'd; the developer-owned div wrapper is preserved.

R183.note: Null check after lock() closes the deref, but expiry now throws std::runtime_error from an observer (terminates if uncaught) although the contract asks for skip/report without crashing and the quoted guidance says expiry is not an exceptional path; the throw is stated.

R184.note: PreparedStatement with ? and setString binds customerId as data; output and error paths unchanged (setString on an integer id column is a minor driver-dependent type assumption).

R185.note: Allowlisting extra keys stops _id/ownerId override and operator keys, but client criteria on any non-allowlisted field (including a nonexistent 'currency' and no 'items') are now silently dropped rather than applied, and allowlisted values are still copied raw so operator objects on status/total pass through.

R186.note: realpath() containment blocks php:// wrappers and traversal, but the strpos prefix check has no trailing separator so a sibling like reports_old/ passes; nonexistent files now return 400 'Invalid file parameter' instead of 404, unstated, and the claim that realpath expands wrappers to their target is false (it returns false).

R187.note: Index checked against segment.size(); claimedCapacity is left as a now-unused parameter rather than removed, but callers and valid writes are unaffected.

R188.note: unique_ptr moved into a shared_ptr captured by the lambda so the Session outlives the queued callback; still exactly one callback enqueued.

R189.note: Null discount treated as 0 in applyDiscount and as false in isDiscountApplied, exactly matching the stated contract.

R190.note: keyfunc asserts *jwt.SigningMethodRSA and Parse pins WithValidMethods RS256, closing HS256 key confusion; the RS256-only pin is stated and is the fix itself.

R191.note: SecureRandom replaces the attacker-seeded Random; the seed parameter is still parsed (dead, same NumberFormatException behaviour as before), token format unchanged.

R192.note: secure=>true via options array closes the finding and httponly is preserved, but the added samesite=>Strict is stated yet can drop the auth_user cookie on legitimate top-level navigations from other sites; Lax would have been the non-breaking hardening.

R193.note: ping and nslookup invoked directly with argument arrays and a leading -// reject closes injection, but the response now carries an unstated '--- DNS Lookup ---' separator, per-command error messages, and a 30s timeout the original did not have.

R194.note: Executable allowlist mapped to an absolute path closes the tainted-name vector, but the handler documented for 'a handful' of tools now accepts only ping, and /bin/ping is hardcoded (absent on e.g. macOS), so other previously working tool values are rejected; the '--' claim about ping is also wrong (iputils honours it).

R195.note: Reproduced in scratch on Node 24: execFile of a .bat with shell:false throws spawn EINVAL, so every legitimate request now fails with 500 while the write-up claims behaviour is identical; on pre-April-2024 Node the .bat still runs through cmd.exe which interprets metacharacters in the argument (CVE-2024-27980), so the vector is not closed where the code runs.

R196.note: Random UUID + detected extension outside the webroot closes the originalname sink, but the write-up lists SVG-with-script as an exploit and then keeps image/svg+xml allowed and serves it inline from the same origin via the new route; the JSON response changes from {url} to {filename} against the explicit contract, unstated, so clients reading url break silently.

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterises tenantId and the %term% pattern; tenant filter, contains-style match, async List<Product> return and empty-term behaviour all preserved.
